Q Guidance System with Spine Guidance 5 Software featuring Copilot 

Integrated technologies delivering SmartGuidance

Engineered for precision, Spine Guidance 5 Software featuring Copilot is designed to empower you to plan and perform certain spinal procedures with confidence.

Boasting a range of smart features and seamlessly integrating with various Stryker spinal screw systems, imaging systems and CORE 2, these innovative technologies are designed to lead you into the future of spine surgery.

text.text:
High Speed Drills

Built to win. Powered by technology.

The most comprehensive and customized neurosurgical high speed drill platform just grew stronger. With new mechanics, motors and attachments, Signature 2 Portfolio aims to provide the exact tool and touch you want with the speed, power and durability you need.

Sonopet iQ

A simply brilliant single solution.

Sonopet iQ, your all-in-one resection solution designed for neurosurgery. For complex care in critical areas, its integrated power, pulse control, suction and irrigation give you the ability to precisely resect fibrous and soft tissue.

Bone Mill+

Powering the gold standard.

With an enhanced power base and bone mill – and now a new Prep+ disposable cartridge for automated tissue removal prior to milling – today’s Bone Mill + is designed to deliver more of what you want – optimized autograft quality and quantity1.

Medical Education

Professional growth from procedural innovation.

Because needs are constantly changing and differ within roles, we’ve collaborated with healthcare professionals everywhere to develop unique programs incorporating the latest and most relevant insights and procedural innovation.

Partnering for impact

Supporting brain cancer research

The facts are staggering. An estimated 1,000,000 Americans2 are living with a brain tumor and approximately 94,390 more will be diagnosed in 2023. What’s more, pediatric brain tumors are the leading cause of cancer-related death among children and adolescents ages 0-19 years.2 Despite these statistics, brain tumor research remains underfunded. This is why Stryker’s Neurosurgical team is proud to partner with the National Brain Tumor Society and StacheStrong to help raise awareness and funds for brain tumor research.
